string.text: GUI
Reactive BHS

Parks classic BHS as one pack (body, limbs, psy, rad, stam). Conditions and damage/hold unpark the whole pack. Stam can also unpark alone. Status icons use separate gates. Turn Medik Status icons ON if Medik is installed.
Hide BHS by default (body, limbs, psy, rads, stam)
Park body, limbs, psy, rad, and stam together. They show together on hold, damage, or an always-show condition. Stam can still unpark alone via its override below.
Show BHS
Unpark the BHS pack (body, limbs, psy, rad, stam) while held. Status icons stay separate. No key bound by default.
Show BHS on damage (body or limbs)
Unpark the BHS pack after a body or limb hit. Duration below; 0 disables. Full-heal clamp can shorten a flash that is still running.
Shown duration (seconds)
How long the damage override keeps BHS unparked after a hit. Further hits refresh the timer. 0 = off.
Full-heal clamp (seconds)
If all limbs heal to full during a damage flash, remaining show time is clamped to this value. 0 = hide immediately when full.
Always show BHS while condition true
Checked first: if any condition below is true, keep the BHS pack up. Damage/hold are extra timed or held overrides on top. Sliders at 0 disable that condition.
Show BHS when body health below (%)
Keep the BHS pack up while actor health is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when limb health below (%)
Keep the BHS pack up while any limb's permanent health is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show just stamina when below (%)
Unpark only the stamina bar while power is under this percent. Does not bring up the rest of BHS. 0 = off.
Show BHS when psy health below (%)
Keep the BHS pack up while psy is under this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when radiation above (%)
Keep the BHS pack up while radiation is above this percent. 0 = off.
Show BHS when have temp health
Keep the BHS pack up while any limb has temporary (green) health.
Keep showing BHS for
Seconds to keep the BHS pack up after all always-show conditions become false. 0 = hide immediately.
Hide status icons
Manage the status icon strip: hide by default, then show only opted-in icons below (and while the status hold key is down).
Show status icons key (hold)
Show opted-in status icons while held, including grey. No key bound by default.
Show radiation when not grey
Allow the radiation status icon when yellow or worse. Grey uses the grace slider at the bottom.
Show bleed when not grey
Allow the bleed status icon (Actor Damage Balancer) when yellow or worse.
Show hunger when not grey
Allow the hunger status icon when yellow or worse.
Show thirst when not grey
Allow the thirst status icon when yellow or worse.
Show sleep when not grey
Allow the sleep status icon when yellow or worse.
Hide grey status icon after
Seconds to keep a grey (mild) opted-in icon visible after it becomes grey, then hide it. 0 = never show grey. Yellow+ clears the timer.
Thirst blur FX starts at yellow
Thirst screen blur starts at yellow instead of gray. Yellow is a soft flash; orange/red intensity follows deprivation.
